# GAD Escalation Protocol

## Routing Rule

Chapter 7 defines trigger conditions. Chapter 8 defines decision procedure. Chapter 4 defines ownership.

| Trigger class | Initial owner | Human authority | Time target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flow/dependency | Delivery Lead | if commitment changes | local policy |
| Validation/evidence | Validation/Evidence Owner | if consequential | local policy |
| A3/A4 authorization | Human Project Hub / named authority | mandatory | local policy |
| Security/privacy/compliance | Specialist control owner | as required | severity policy |
| Authority/tool/data expansion | Human Project Hub / enterprise authority | mandatory | before action |
| Systemic control failure | Governance Owner | mandatory review | severity policy |

## Escalation Package
- work item;
- trigger;
- current state;
- evidence;
- risk/uncertainty;
- action already taken;
- side effects;
- decision required;
- deadline/impact.

## Fail-Closed Rule
Do not cross the affected mandatory boundary while escalation is unresolved.
